column1: Infusion and syringe pump preventive maintenance checklist

column2: Use the manufacturer's battery test and record the measured runtime or condition
Replace swollen, leaking or failing packs with the specified type only
Follow the manufacturer's steps after pack replacement and recheck battery alarms
Check the mains-failure alarm by pulling mains during a run
Inspect for fluid residue, corrosion and cracks at every PM
Compare the ward's disinfectant with the manufacturer's compatible list
Clear the maintenance reminder only after the PM is complete, by the manufacturer's procedure
Record values, instruments, parts and the next due date
